messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Request help_shared component model using binomial family with INLA
parts:
You have to check the variable 'Var1', which has to be numerics with
values in 1:m, where m is the size of the graph.

f.ex, if 'Var1' is a factor, that does not work. I *guess* this is the
case here.
